nodes.label: Vencore Monorepo Architecture
nodes.rationale: Turborepo + pnpm workspaces monorepo with apps: web (Next.js dashboard), api (Express REST), worker (background jobs), agent (Node.js daemon on customer servers). Multi-tenant with workspace-scoped auth using custom JWT.

hyperedges.label: Vencore Project Documentation Set
hyperedges.rationale: These four root-level files collectively define the Vencore project: technical context (CLAUDE.md), product overview (README.md), contribution norms (CONTRIBUTING.md), and community standards (CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
